name: value-to-market-v2
description: Test version of the Value-to-Market (V2M) Framework by Hoang Huynh, organized by job: assess, build or fine-tune a value proposition, or build a value strategy, turn it into an operational Value to Market plan, or realign plan and strategy with reality, with an optional agentic mode. One skill, one copy of the method, Socratic conversation, and reports clustered by phase with no overlap.
